column1: # DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake (01003E601E324000) on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# The profile is upstream's Mac (iOS) bring-up of update 1.1.2; this Android port packs the same version and patches its main build
# (patches.py, ue_malloc.tsv, dm/tools/sdk_patches.py). Unreal Engine 4.27 (MallocBinned3, a 62 GB engine region by default) as
# DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined: the region is capped at 2 GB with game_args (-SwitchVirtualAddressSpaceSize=2048), the allocator's
# constructor call is cut and the host runs Unreal's heap (hle_uemalloc.c), the SDK's node area is cut to 62 MB (sdk_patches.py) and
# the engine's pak index key is read from main's code (uepak.py code_keys). The build read the game out of the player's own NSPs
# (the base game's 7.0 GB one and the update's 0.8 GB one).
# Brought up 2026-11-28 on the Legion Y700 (TB321FU, Adreno 750, Android 16, Turnip 26.2.3), docked 1920x1080: the logos and the
# opening movie, the title, a new adventure log (name, appearance, voice language, difficulty), the opening into the prologue's church by
# the water, 30 fps (frame p50 33.7 ms, GPU p50 22.8 ms) over about 10 minutes; no red line at run time. Battles, saves, the field menu
# and handheld mode are not tested yet.
